entities.summary: Fujiwara no Koretada/Koremasa, also known as Ichijō Sesshō, was a Japanese statesman, courtier, politician and waka-poet during the Heian period. His poems were published in "The Collected Poems of the First Ward Regent", Ichijo Sessho Gyoshu, and in Hyakunin Isshu. He was handsome and wise, and his personality was flashy.
